entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Isaac. How can I help you today?
Yeah, Isaac, I need to return this jersey I bought. It's ridiculous. I've been a customer for years and this is just unacceptable.
I'm sorry to hear you're having an issue. I can certainly look into that for you. To get started, can I have your order number?
It's VF88602. Look, I don't have time for a runaround. The jersey is the wrong size. It's way too tight and I can't even ride in it. I need to exchange it or get my money back now.
Okay, I see the order for the Aero Race Jersey. I understand it's a sizing issue. Just to be sure, is it a technical fault with the material or a preference issue with the fit?

What kind of stupid question is that? I just told you it's the wrong size! It's too tight! Is this how you guys operate now, interrogating customers? Just process the return! I swear I'll light you up on every review site if this takes any longer. Get me a manager.
I understand your frustration, and there's no need for a manager. I can handle this for you. I just needed to confirm the reason. Let me quickly review our policy for you, one moment.

Thank you for your patience. I've checked our policy, and you're unfortunately outside the 10-day return window. I can absolutely process a return for a full refund or an exchange for a different size. Which would you prefer?
Fine. An exchange. I need the next size up. A large.

Excellent. I've just initiated the exchange for the Aero Race Jersey in a size large. I'm also sending a prepaid return label to the email address on file for the medium-sized jersey. Just pack it up, attach the label, and drop it at any post office. Your new item will ship out as soon as the return is scanned.
Got the email. Should've been that easy from the start. Thanks.
You're welcome. Is there anything else I can help you with today?
Alright. Thank you for calling VeloFit. Have a great day.
